title: Pecan Pie Cookies
description: Sweet, nutty cookies inspired by pecan pie — dehydrated at low heat for a delicious toffee-like chewy texture. Made with pecans, Medjool dates and maple syrup.
steps: Hold back 12–14 pecan halves; blitz the remainder in a blender to tiny pieces.
Blitz the dates in the blender until finely chopped (chop by hand if needed to avoid clogging the blender).
Mix the nuts and dates together until combined, then stir in the maple syrup.

Use teaspoons to place small heaps of the mixture on a baking sheet lined with greaseproof paper, a few centimetres apart. Flatten with the back of a spoon or fork, and press a pecan half on top of each.
Bake for around 45 minutes, or until the cookies are just holding together. Let them cool completely on the baking sheet.
notes: Makes 12–14 cookies. Per cookie estimate. Can be left raw — chill in the fridge for 2–3 hours to set instead of baking.
